name: views-setup
description: app/ is the Next.js App Router root (decision 0002): app/layout.tsx and app/page.tsx; next.config.ts holds Next's config, vitest.config.ts the tests'. React is the UI library. The engine never imports app/, react or next (tests/guards/engine-purity.ts). Check phone width too; the end target is a Discord Activity.

next build rewrites tsconfig.json when it lacks Next's settings (allowJs, incremental, esModuleInterop, resolveJsonModule, jsx react-jsx, the .next/types and .next/dev/types includes, exclude node_modules), so a build dirties the tree. Those values are committed; keep them when editing tsconfig.json.
resolution: Run npm run build after any tsconfig.json edit and commit what Next writes. next-env.d.ts and *.tsbuildinfo are generated and gitignored.

name: drei-view-one-canvas
description: Many 3D views on one page (the rune hotbar): one fixed, pointer-events:none Canvas with <View.Port/>, and a drei <View> div per place. Browsers cap live WebGL contexts at about 16. A View re-reads its div's getBoundingClientRect every frame, so a CSS transform on the div (FLIP) animates the 3D across the page; app/design/runes/RuneDashboard.tsx does the summon this way.
After npm run build, a still-running next start on the same port keeps serving the old build: the new server fails with EADDRINUSE and pages 500 on stale chunks.
resolution: pkill -f 'next-server|next start' and check the server log for 'Ready' before driving the page.

content: The rune page reads docs/design/rune-reference.md at build time (app/design/runes/reference.ts) instead of copying it; the parser throws on a table it cannot read so the build fails loudly. When the doc's table shape changes, update the parser and its fixture in the same change.

description: A Playwright fullPage screenshot of a design page cuts off the 3D
resolution: The shared drei View canvas is position: fixed and covers only the viewport. Scroll and take viewport screenshots instead.

content: Rune tables via app/design/runes/reference.ts; the ground each major rune makes via app/design/crafter/grounds.ts (system-b.md 'Major rune | The ground it makes'). Both throw on a changed doc shape. Rules restated in app/design/crafter/sigil.ts cite their doc section and status; recheck them when system-b.md changes.
